$description: Base glass primitives and the stacking scale.

blur.$description: The one backdrop blur. Declared here and nowhere else.

dither.$description: The grain that keeps 8-bit banding out of soft shadows and gradients. These four numbers ARE the noise: build.mjs serializes them into the feTurbulence data URI it emits as --dither-noise, so the SVG has no hand-written home. Change a number here and the grain changes everywhere.

strength.$description: Overlay opacity. 0 turns the grain off everywhere at once.

frequency.$description: feTurbulence baseFrequency. Higher is finer grain.

octaves.$description: feTurbulence numOctaves. More octaves is more structure per tile.

tile.$description: Repeat size of the noise tile. stitchTiles makes the seam invisible.

z.$description: Named stacking layers. Closed set: invariant z-scale admits no z-index outside it.
